Dearest Abby,

Happy Sunday! “How could a Sunday be happy?”, you ask? Well, maybe they can’t be fully happy… but I wanted to help make them just a little less scary.

Welcome to the Sunday Unscaries, Maddie’s first ever web app (pardon the dust). It’s basically a halfway-iOS-app that I can update easily remotely without paying Apple jillions of dollars…

How does it work? Every Sunday, you’ll be pushed an “unscary” to help you get through the day. They can be all kinds of formats - some may just be me babbling like this, others will involve getting something from that big box I gave you…point is, they’re surprises, and I hope they make your Sundays a little more bearable.
